features.label: Haematuria
features.question: Has haematuria been documented?
features.help: Includes microscopic and visible haematuria. Record the subtype separately when known. A missing urine result is unknown, not absent.
features.definition: Documented blood in the urine, including microscopic or visible haematuria; the subtype may be known or unknown.
features.notes: Do not infer from proteinuria or a diagnosis of Alport syndrome. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Broaden the definition to include known subtypes. The parent concept does not mean subtype unknown.

features.label: Microscopic haematuria
features.question: Has microscopic haematuria been documented on urine testing?
features.help: Specifically documented microscopic haematuria.
features.definition: Specifically documented microscopic haematuria.
features.notes: Do not infer microscopic haematuria from an unspecified haematuria record. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain documented microscopic haematuria. Do not treat unspecified haematuria as sufficient evidence or introduce a new RBC threshold.

features.label: Visible haematuria
features.question: Has visible blood in the urine been documented?
features.help: Documented macroscopic haematuria.
features.definition: Documented macroscopic haematuria.
features.notes: Retain separately from microscopic haematuria; no persistence or cause is inferred. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain visible haematuria. Record the historical event; no inference of persistence or cause.

features.label: Hearing impairment
features.question: Has hearing impairment been documented?
features.help: Includes hearing impairment with a known or unknown type. Record sensorineural type and laterality separately when documented.
features.definition: Documented reduction in hearing, whether or not the type or laterality is known.
features.notes: Does not establish sensorineural impairment or laterality. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Correct overly narrow unspecified-type definition. Known sensorineural impairment also falls within the broad concept.

features.label: Sensorineural hearing impairment
features.question: Has sensorineural hearing impairment been documented on hearing assessment?
features.help: Documented sensorineural hearing impairment.
features.definition: Documented sensorineural hearing impairment.
features.notes: General hearing difficulty alone does not establish this finding. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain explicit hearing-assessment evidence; subjective hearing difficulty cannot establish the type.

features.label: Bilateral sensorineural hearing impairment
features.question: Has sensorineural hearing impairment in both ears been documented?
features.help: Documented sensorineural impairment affecting both ears.
features.definition: Documented sensorineural impairment affecting both ears.
features.notes: Do not infer laterality from an unspecified hearing impairment record. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain explicit documentation that both ears are affected; preserve laterality.

features.label: Renal cyst
features.question: Has at least one renal cyst been documented on imaging?
features.help: Includes a single cyst or multiple cysts. This finding alone does not establish cystic dysplasia or inherited cystic disease.
features.definition: One or more documented renal cysts; number, distribution and morphology require separate detail.
features.notes: Does not establish multiple cysts, dysplasia or inherited cystic disease. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Clarify one-or-more wording so multiple cysts do not appear excluded by a singular question.

features.label: Multiple renal cysts
features.question: Have multiple renal cysts been documented on imaging?
features.help: Multiple renal cysts explicitly documented in an imaging report.
features.definition: Multiple renal cysts explicitly documented in an imaging report.
features.notes: Do not infer from a record that mentions only a renal cyst; no new numerical cutoff is proposed. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain report-based multiple-cyst finding. The ontology does not supply a numerical cutoff to implement here.

features.label: Chronic kidney disease
features.question: Has chronic kidney disease been documented?
features.help: Documented CKD; this question does not derive chronicity from test results.
features.definition: Documented CKD; this question does not derive chronicity from test results.
features.notes: A single reduced eGFR is insufficient to answer this documented-history question. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain documented CKD history. Automated chronicity assessment requires a separate dated rule.

features.label: Renal insufficiency
features.question: Has renal insufficiency or impaired kidney function been documented?
features.help: Documented impaired kidney function without an assertion of chronicity or stage.
features.definition: Documented impaired kidney function without an assertion of chronicity or stage.
features.notes: Candidate wording needs review because the source term is broad; do not equate it with confirmed CKD. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain as broad context/fallback when this is what the record supports; do not make it an independent disease-discriminating score or require it to be answered again after CKD.

features.label: Hypertension
features.question: Has hypertension been documented?
features.help: Documented hypertension without deriving a diagnosis from a single blood pressure.
features.definition: Documented hypertension without deriving a diagnosis from a single blood pressure.
features.notes: Age at onset, severity and measurement thresholds are not captured. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain documented hypertension. A single elevated blood pressure is not equivalent to the HPO chronic-pressure concept.

features.label: Stage 5 chronic kidney disease
features.question: Has stage 5 chronic kidney disease been documented?
features.help: Explicit documentation of CKD stage 5.
features.definition: Explicit documentation of CKD stage 5.
features.notes: Do not infer stage from any kidney disease or dialysis mention alone. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain explicit documented stage. Do not require dialysis or infer this stage from any dialysis exposure.

features.label: Ataxia
features.question: Has ataxia been documented on clinical assessment?
features.help: Documented ataxia.
features.definition: Documented ataxia.
features.notes: Unspecified imbalance or dizziness is not automatically equivalent. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain clinician-documented impaired coordination; unqualified dizziness or imbalance is insufficient.

features.label: Hypotonia
features.question: Has hypotonia been documented on clinical assessment?
features.help: Documented reduced muscle tone.
features.definition: Documented reduced muscle tone.
features.notes: Do not equate muscle weakness with reduced muscle tone. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain documented reduced muscle tone; weakness is a different finding.

features.label: Global developmental delay
features.question: Was global developmental delay documented in early childhood, before age five?
features.help: An older patient can have a documented childhood history. Do not use a new assessment of adult difficulties or an isolated developmental concern to establish this finding. If the childhood timing cannot be established, record unknown.
features.definition: A documented history of global developmental delay in a child younger than five at the relevant assessment.
features.notes: Do not infer this from one isolated developmental concern. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Add age at the historical assessment. The source definition restricts this term to children younger than five.

features.label: Renal cell carcinoma
features.question: Has renal cell carcinoma been documented?
features.help: A documented renal cell carcinoma diagnosis.
features.definition: A documented renal cell carcinoma diagnosis.
features.notes: An unspecified renal mass is not equivalent; record timing separately before use in pre-diagnosis research. Question wording is locally authored and pending review.

editorialReview.rationale: Retain explicit documented tumour diagnosis. An unspecified renal mass is insufficient; preserve diagnosis date for later research use.
